description: This file defines a custom stream filter implementation and an abstract base class for stream filtering tests within an Orleans-based testing framework. It includes logic for filtering items based on filter data and provides test scenarios such as ignoring bad filters and filtering even items.

classes.name: CustomStreamFilter
classes.description: Implements a custom stream filter that filters items based on provided filter data, specifically handling 'throw', 'even', 'only3', and 'only7' filters.

classes.name: StreamFilteringTestsBase
classes.description: An abstract base class for stream filtering tests, providing common setup and test methods to verify stream filtering behavior, including handling bad filters and multiple filters.

methods.name: ShouldDeliver
methods.description: Determines whether an item should be delivered based on the filter data, with exception handling and logging.

methods.name: ShouldDeliverImpl
methods.description: Contains the core logic to decide if an item passes the filter based on filter data.

methods.name: IgnoreBadFilter
methods.description: Test method to verify behavior when the filter throws an exception ('throw' filter).

methods.name: OnlyEvenItems
methods.description: Test method to verify filtering of even items only.

methods.name: MultipleSubscriptionsDifferentFilterData
methods.description: Test method to verify multiple subscriptions with different filter data.

methods.name: EnsureStreamFilterIsRegistered
methods.description: Checks if the custom stream filter is registered and throws an exception if not.
